facts.v: Cyclades-wide, covering Mykonos, Tinos, Andros, Syros and Naxos, not only Mykonos
A kopanisti from Ikaria is also on the Greek list; no details on how it is made

sources.text: PDO, Cyclades (1994); raw or lightly thermised milk of cow, sheep, goat or mixes, no starters; peppery, kneaded and ripened in jars. Sources disagree (30-40 vs 45-60 days); the PDO minimum was not found
